When Gina has lost her job at Door Dash?
What do Jon and Gina both have in common?
qa.answer: They lost their jobs and decided to start their own businesses.

qa.question: What Jon thinks the ideal dance studio should look like?
qa.answer: By the water, with natural light and Marley flooring

When did Gina launch an ad campaign for her store?

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.text: Hey Jon! Good to see you. What's up? Anything new?

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.text: Hey Gina! Good to see you too. Lost my job as a banker yesterday, so I'm gonna take a shot at starting my own business.

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.text: Sorry about your job Jon, but starting your own business sounds awesome! Unfortunately, I also lost my job at Door Dash this month. What business are you thinking of?

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.text: Sorry to hear that! I'm starting a dance studio 'cause I'm passionate about dancing and it'd be great to share it with others.

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.text: That's cool, Jon! What got you into this biz?

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.text: I've been into dancing since I was a kid and it's been my passion and escape. I wanna start a dance studio so I can teach others the joy that dancing brings me.

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.text: Wow Jon, same here! Dance is pretty much my go-to for stress relief. Got any fave styles?

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.text: Cool, Gina! I love all dances, but contemporary is my top pick. It's so expressive and powerful! What's your fave?

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.text: Yeah, me too! Contemporary dance is so expressive and graceful - it really speaks to me.

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.text: Wow, great idea! Let's go to a dance class, it'll be so much fun!

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.text: Yeah! Let's explore some new dance moves. We should plan a dance session soon!

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.text: Yeah definitely! Wanna see my moves next Fri? Can't wait!

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.text: Sounds great, Jon! Next Friday works. Let's boogie!

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.blip_caption: a photography of a man in a suit is performing a dance
session_1.query: dancing on stage performance dance competition last year
session_1.text: Wow, I'm excited too! This is gonna be great!

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.text: Wow! What did you get?

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.text: Woah, that pic's from when my dance crew took home first in a local comp last year. It was amazing up on that stage! I'm super keen to spread that intensity with other peeps. Gina, you ever been in any dance comps or shows?

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.blip_caption: a photography of a couple of people standing next to each other
session_1.text: I used to compete in a few dance competitions and shows - my fav memory was when my team won first place at a regionals at age fifteen. It was an awesome feeling of accomplishment!

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.text: Wow! Winning first place is amazing! What dance were you doing?

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.blip_caption: a photo of a large open porch with a fireplace and a view of the water
session_1.text: Thanks! We just did a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom." It was really emotional and powerful.

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.blip_caption: a photography of a room with a view of the ocean and a few yoga mats
session_1.text: Wow, that must've been great! Check my ideal dance studio by the water.

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.text: Cool setup! Man, you can't deny that view! Got time to rehearse with a biz and a new store?

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.text: Hopefully, we will find a place like this that will inspire us!

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.text: Wow, it looks great! What dances do you practice? Got any projects planned?

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.blip_caption: a photo of a group of dancers in white dresses on a stage
session_1.text: Thanks! I rehearsed with a small group of dancers after work. We do all kinds of dances, from contemporary to hip-hop. We've got some cool projects in the works. Finishing up choreography to perform at a nearby festival next month. Can't wait!

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.text: Wow, it looks awesome! Are they yours at the festival? They're so graceful!

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.text: Yeah, they're the ones performing at the festival! They've been practicing hard and will definitely impress with their grace and skill.

session_1.speaker: Gina
session_1.text: Wow, they look great! Can't wait to see them rock the festival. Gonna be awesome!

session_1.speaker: Jon
session_1.text: Yeah, awesome! Glad to be part of it.

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.blip_caption: a photo of a clothing store with a variety of clothes on display
session_2.text: Hey Jon! Long time no see! Things have been hectic lately. I just launched an ad campaign for my clothing store in hopes of growing the business. Starting my own store and taking risks is both scary and rewarding. I'm excited to see where it takes me!

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Hey Gina! Whoa, your store looks great! All your hard work really paid off - congrats! Must be awesome to see your stuff on display.

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Thanks a bunch! It's awesome seeing my vision happen. How's the dance studio going? Did you find the right spot?

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.blip_caption: a photo of a bathroom with a blue floor and a pink wall
session_2.query: dance studio natural lighting spacious room large windows dance mirrors
session_2.text: Hey Gina! Thanks for asking. I'm on the hunt for the ideal spot for my dance studio and it's been quite a journey! I've been looking at different places and picturing how the space would look. I even found a place with great natural light! Oh, I've been to Paris yesterday! It was sooo cool.

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Wow, nice spot! Where is it? Got any other features you want to think about before you decide? Paris?! That is really great Jon! Never had a chance to visit it. Been only to Rome once.

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: It's downtown which is awesome cuz it's easy to get to. Plus the natural light! Gotta check the size & floor quality too. We need a good dance floor with enough bounce for me & my students to dance safely.

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Definitely! Dance floors help avoid injuries and make dancing more enjoyable. You thinking about it is great. Any particular type of flooring you like?

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Yeah, good flooring's crucial. I'm after Marley flooring, which is what dance studios usually use. It's great 'cause it's grippy but still lets you move, plus it's tough and easy to keep clean.

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Sounds great! Marley's perfect; it's got the right amount of grip and movement. Can't wait to see your dance studio done!

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Yeah, can't wait to see it done! Looking for the right place and getting everything ready has been a mix of exciting and nerve-wracking, but I'm determined to make it work. It'll be worth it!

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Believe in yourself, Jon! The process may be tough, but you got this. Push through and it'll be worth it. Don't forget to take breaks and dance it out when you need to destress!

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Glad I have you in my corner! Gotta make time to dance and vent, that's for sure. We'll make it through this - hang in there!

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Let's keep going and chase our dreams!

session_2.speaker: Gina
session_2.text: Yeah! We've done so much, and there's nothing but good stuff coming. Let's keep going after our goals and making them happen.

session_2.speaker: Jon
session_2.text: Success is almost here. We got this!

session_3.speaker: Jon
session_3.text: Hey Gina, hope you're doing ok! Still following my passion for dance. It's been bumpy, but I'm determined to make it work. I'm still searching for a place to open my dance studio.

session_3.speaker: Gina
session_3.blip_caption: a photography of a shopping mall with a glass entrance and a sign
session_3.text: Hi Jon! So happy you're pushing forward with dancing! Inspiring 💪 I emailed some wholesalers and one replied and said yes today! I'm over the moon because now I can expand my clothing store and get closer to my customers. Check it out - here's a pic!

session_3.speaker: Jon
session_3.blip_caption: a photo of a room with a mirror and a wooden floor
session_3.text: Wow, Gina! You found the perfect spot for your store. Way to go, hard work's paying off!

session_3.speaker: Gina
session_3.blip_caption: a photography of a clothing store with a lot of clothes on display
session_3.query: inside of store cozy inviting atmosphere trendy pieces
session_3.text: Thanks! Glad you like it. Yeah, it's a great spot. Here's a peek at the space I designed. Cozy and inviting - perfect for customers to check out all the trendy pieces.

session_3.speaker: Jon
session_3.text: Wow, it looks great! Must've taken you ages to design it. What made you pick out the furniture and decor?

session_3.speaker: Gina
session_3.text: Thanks! It took a bit of time but I wanted to make the place look like my own style and make my customers feel cozy. I chose furniture that looks great and is comfy too. The chandelier adds a nice glam feel while matching the style of the store.

session_3.speaker: Jon
session_3.text: Your store looks great - your customers will be so comfy.

session_3.speaker: Gina
session_3.text: Thanks! Making my spot comfortable and inviting for my customers is key. I want 'em to feel like they're in a cool oasis. Just creating an experience that'll make 'em wanna come back.

session_3.speaker: Jon
session_3.text: That's a great goal! Creating a special experience for customers is the key to making them feel welcome and coming back. I think you can create that space you're imagining.

session_3.speaker: Gina
session_3.text: Thanks. Your support means a lot. I'm sure with my hard work and effort, I can make a special shopping experience for my customers. It's tough but I'm up for the challenge!

session_3.speaker: Jon
session_3.text: I'm always here to support you! Go create something awesome with your store. Keep it up!

session_3.speaker: Gina
session_3.text: Thanks, Jon! I'll try my best. You're gonna do great with your dance studio, just keep going and stay positive! We'll get through this!

session_3.speaker: Jon
session_3.text: Thanks! Your words mean a lot. I'm staying positive and pushing forward. We've put our hearts into our dreams and I'm sure we'll make it.

session_3.speaker: Gina
session_3.text: Sure thing, Jon! Stay motivated and keep going. Hard work pays off eventually. We can do this!

session_4.speaker: Jon
session_4.text: Hey Gina! What's up? How's the store going? I gotta tell you about this thing with my biz.

session_4.speaker: Gina
session_4.text: Hey Jon! The store's doing great! It's a wild ride. How's the biz?

session_4.speaker: Jon
session_4.text: Hey Gina! I'm putting in a lot of work on my business even with the obstacles. I'm gonna make it happen!

session_4.speaker: Gina
session_4.text: Wow! You've got drive! Keep it up and you'll definitely make a splash.

session_4.speaker: Jon
session_4.text: Thanks Gina! Your help really means a lot. Sometimes it's hard when things don't go my way, but I'm sure if I keep pushing, I'll reach my dreams!

session_4.speaker: Gina
session_4.text: Understand where you're at, Jon. Setbacks are just opportunities for comebacks. You got the skills, passion, and drive. Plus my full support. Don't give up, buddy!

session_4.speaker: Jon
session_4.text: Thanks! Setbacks can be tough, but with your support, I can handle anything. Appreciate you having my back!

session_4.speaker: Gina
session_4.text: I'm here for you no matter what! Anything you want to say about your biz?

session_4.speaker: Jon
session_4.text: Searching for a dance studio location has been tricky, but I'm determined to find the right spot - when I do, I'm sure the rest will follow!

session_4.speaker: Gina
session_4.text: Searching for the perfect dance studio's a tough job, Jon. Hang in there and you'll find it soon!

session_4.speaker: Jon
session_4.blip_caption: a photo of a woman in a gray dress doing a trick
session_4.text: Thanks! Appreciate your encouragement - it means a lot! I'm working on my business and some new dance routines - rehearsing hard for an upcoming show. I'm passionate about dancing and it brings me so much joy and fulfillment.

session_4.speaker: Gina
session_4.text: Wow, Jon! You're so talented! What show ya got planned?

session_4.speaker: Jon
session_4.text: I'm getting ready for a dance comp near me next month. It's a great chance for me to show my skillz and, hopefully, get some props from the dance fam. Super stoked!

session_4.speaker: Gina
session_4.text: Wow Jon, you're gonna kill it in that competition. Your hard work and talent will pay off! Good luck.

session_4.speaker: Jon
session_4.text: Thanks! Your help means a lot. I'll do my best to make you proud!

session_4.speaker: Gina
session_4.text: No doubt, Jon you've got this. Your passion and commitment are awesome! Keep it up!

session_4.speaker: Jon
session_4.text: Thanks! I'm going for my dreams!

session_4.speaker: Gina
session_4.text: Absolutely Jon. I'm always here to cheer you on. Make your dreams happen - keep going and believe in yourself. You got this!

session_4.speaker: Jon
session_4.text: Thanks, Gina! Your kind words mean a lot. I won't give up!

session_5.speaker: Gina
session_5.blip_caption: a photo of a group of women posing with a giant balloon
session_5.text: Hey Jon! Great hearing from you again. How have you been? BTW, I found a cool new fashion piece for my store. Can't wait to share with my customers.

session_5.speaker: Jon
session_5.blip_caption: a photo of a group of young girls in a dance studio
session_5.text: Hey Gina! Congrats on the new fashion piece! Looks like your store is growing. Remenber the festival I told you about? Had that performance and it was awesome - so many people there complementing my dance moves. Dancing brings me joy and it was nice to be reminded why I'm passionate about it.

session_5.speaker: Gina
session_5.text: Wow! That looks great. You look badass on stage. BTW, what's your favorite part of running your own studio?

session_5.speaker: Jon
session_5.text: Thanks, Gina! I love running my own studio. It's great having the freedom to create a space and help dancers of all ages and levels express themselves. I'm super thrilled about dancing each day and seeing my students progress. It's so fulfilling.

session_5.speaker: Gina
session_5.blip_caption: a photo of a rack of clothes with a coat and a dress
session_5.text: That's awesome! I'm sure you feel great knowing your students are doing so well with dance. It's amazing what it can do for people! Oh, and btw - I've been working hard on my online store and just teamed up with a local artist for some cool designs. Check 'em out!

session_5.speaker: Jon
session_5.text: It looks awesome. Your commitment and creativity in your business really stands out. How'd you come up with these cool designs?

session_5.speaker: Gina
session_5.text: Thanks Jon! I got the idea from a fashion mag and saw there wasn't much around like it. So I worked with the artist to make it happen - it's all about being ahead of the game and giving my customers something different.

session_5.speaker: Jon
session_5.text: Nice one, Gina! You never shy away from a challenge and always try something new. I'm impressed by your willingness to take risks - it's really inspiring.

session_5.speaker: Gina
session_5.text: Thanks! Taking risks is scary but it's the only way to grow, right? Just part of the journey to success.

session_5.speaker: Jon
session_5.text: Yeah, I totally agree - taking risks is key for success. It's made me grow, and even got me out of my secure 9-5 as a banker. Now, I'm aiming to turn my dancing passion into a business. I'm determined to make it work, I just know it! That being said, I definitely don't underestimate the difficulties - it ain't been a walk in the park, that's for sure.

session_5.speaker: Gina
session_5.text: It's tough starting a biz, but don't let it get you down. You can make your studio work, I'm sure. And remember, I'm always here for you.

session_5.speaker: Jon
session_5.blip_caption: a photography of a cartoon character with a quote about fear
session_5.query: motivational quote "everything you want is on the other side of fear"
session_5.text: Thanks, Gina. Your help means a lot. I'll keep plugging away and stay optimistic.

session_5.speaker: Gina
session_5.blip_caption: a photo of a woman standing on a balcony with a blue dress
session_5.text: This quote kept me positive through tough times. We all need a push sometimes, right? Even made a tattoo to remind myself about it.

session_5.speaker: Jon
session_5.text: Love the tattoo, did you just get it?

session_5.speaker: Gina
session_5.text: Thanks! Got the tattoo a few years ago, it stands for freedom - dancing without worrying what people think. A reminder to follow my passions and express myself.

session_5.speaker: Jon
session_5.blip_caption: a photo of a woman in a tutu posing for a picture
session_5.text: Nice reminder, Gina! It's so important to have freedom and express ourselves without worry. Dance gives me an escape to be myself.

session_5.speaker: Gina
session_5.text: Totally agree, Jon. Dancing lets us be ourselves and ain't nothing like the feeling it gives us. You're so dedicated to your studio, it's inspiring. Chase those dreams, buddy!

session_5.speaker: Jon
session_5.blip_caption: a photo of a trophy with a glass globe on top
session_5.text: Thanks, Gina! Your support means so much. I'm gonna keep chasing after those dreams. Dance is my passion, and I'm gonna keep working hard to make it a success!

session_5.speaker: Gina
session_5.text: This is the right attitude! How have you been juggling dance and business goals?

session_5.speaker: Jon
session_5.text: Thanks! Juggling both my passions can be tricky, but so rewarding. Dancing and running my biz need hard work, plus they give me energy for each other. My dance moves get me pumped to tackle my business goals, and successes there boost my drive to keep dreaming on the dance floor. It's a balancing act, but fun.

session_5.speaker: Gina
session_5.text: Wow, Jon! You're amazing at juggling both your passions. Finding that happy medium is key - keep going and don't stop dreaming, buddy!

session_5.speaker: Jon
session_5.text: Thanks, Gina! Your pep-talk really meant a lot. I'm not gonna give up on my dreams - my dance studio and biz ventures need the hard work I'm putting in. Love having you in my corner, thanks for always being there!

session_5.speaker: Gina
session_5.text: Yeah Jon, I'm here for you! Chasing our dreams and helping each other out. Let's keep movin' forward!
